items.title: Louis Jones Interview, 1959-01-19
items.q: I remember them too, but I can't place them right now.

ctx.x: Around that sound. But he wasn't as much a rag player as Baldwin was.

Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. You remember a couple of boys, Al C. Frank and his brother, Bab Frank. Two fellows that lived uptown here. One played violin, one played piccolo, a little short flute. Bab Frank and then Al C. Frank played violin.

I remember them, but since she spoke, I remember them, but... Pickled about that long. Yeah, it's a little short. I remember them too, but I can't place them right now. I think you're puzzling my husband up here now. You don't have too long. Uh-uh. You're puzzling him up here. Uh-uh.
